findings:
CHAIN FACTS. The chain is the compositor's `preProcess` (StarfishKeyFilter.qml:294-468: AOD-black gating, boot-popup gating before smartTvReady, `views.starfishCoverUI.isOpen` -> NotAccepted, TTS key-speak, MRCU pointer show/hide for non-long-press keys), then the 22 configd handlers in order, then `defaultKeyEventHandler` (Home family only). KeyPolicy native; Accepted = consumed, NextPolicy = continue, NotAccepted = hand to the focused window (stops the chain) [INFERENCE from usage, e.g. digits/tvhotkey keys return NotAccepted after acting]. `handleHomeKeys` is called only from `handleSystemKeys` (systemUi.js:826-830). `handleTunerless` (preProcess.js) and every `easytv.js` handler (handleNotification, handleAvReset, handleEasyTvHotkeys, handleBlockKeys) are defined but have no caller in the whole snapshot and are not in the chain. Each js file is loaded by its own Loader, so state (counters, skip flags) is per file; all share one `longPressTimer` and `genericTimer`.

(a) KEY -> DEFAULT LG DESTINATION (this set: US, uiStyle LG, 2024 keymap, hotel off, remoteSlowInput off)
- Home short (release): launchDefaultApp category home -> com.webos.app.home (LumaHome stub). Home in Home: closes homeView / voice agent. No double-press.
- Home long 2500 ms (2000 if zoom on): Screen Zoom enable, again = zoom controller.
- Menu (My Apps) / keyboard Windows: Home with activateType myapps / Home.
- Back short: close top overlay/alert/home view, else pass to app, else 'Do you want to exit the app?' alert. Back long 1000 ms = Exit: closes whichever UI is up, else applicationManager.close(foreground app).
- Settings gear short: systemUIManager/launch com.webos.app.quicksettings (already LumaGlass QuickSettings.qml); gear long 1000 ms: com.palm.app.settings (toggle); gear x3 in 3 s: tvhotkey mute-hidden-action; gear held ~5 s: HotelModeReady side effect.
- Input short: com.webos.app.quickinputpicker (stock InputPicker.qml); Input long 1000 ms: com.webos.app.homeconnect (Home Hub).
- 123/Screen Remote short: com.webos.app.screenremote (stock ScreenRemote.qml); long 1000 ms: tvhotkey audio-description. Digits held 1000 ms: Quick Access slot / com.webos.app.magicnum for 0.
- Mic: voiceconductor hold down/up -> com.webos.app.voice. Search key: voiceconductor nrcu hold.
- Netflix -> netflix; Prime Video -> amazon; Disney+ -> com.disney.disneyplus-prod (not installed, auto-install); LG Channels -> com.webos.app.lgchannels; Sling -> com.movenetworks.app.sling-tv-sling-production (not installed); Movies(USP) -> com.webos.app.voice runtext search 'movie'; New -> com.webos.app.discovery category/THEME/20411. All other CP keys inactive: toast 'This button is not available.'.
- Guide -> com.webos.app.livemenu (unless Live TV/HDMI/guide focused, then passed to app); ChannelDash/ProgramList/LiveTVMenu -> livemenu channels; Info, Qmenu, Pictures, MagnifierZoom, Red/Green/Yellow short, Blue short, play/pause/FF/REW, Subtitle(Live TV), CH, Return, arrows: not claimed by compositor -> go to the focused app. Red long 1000 ms -> Key_MediaRecord (no handler here; app/Live TV). Yellow held 5 s -> panelcontroller/setAGP test pattern.
- Volume +/-/mute: only audioService (volume OSD). Mute held 2000 ms: accessibility-overlay. CH +/-: only multiview forwarding; otherwise to app.
- Power (Key_webOS_PowerOnOff) has no handler in the QML chain at all: handled below the compositor.
- Notification centre: no key and no handler exists in these files; toasts/alerts are com.webos.notification surfaces (closed by Back, systemUi.js:883-895).
- Multi-view / screen zoom keys: no dedicated MR key on this set; Home long = screen zoom; multiview keys act only when multiViewStatus is on (it is off).
- Screen saver: handleScreenSaver never swallows; first key after wake is processed normally (screensaver app holds focus).
- Gamepad: Menu/Settings buttons map to Menu(Home myapps)/Quick Settings on short release; long press does nothing; Back short/long = Back/Exit; Xbox button -> com.microsoft.xbox (absent). No path in the four files opens Game Dashboard or com.webos.app.gameoptimizer.
- Keyboard: Esc=Back, F2=Input, F4=Home, F5=Settings, F7=LG Channels, F10/11/12 mute/vol-/vol+.
- TV panel joystick (localKeyType onekey): press -> tvhotkey one-local-key; directions are volume/channel or 5-way when a UI has focus.

(b) WHAT LUMATV'S FIRST SLOT MUST INTERCEPT TO REPLACE LG UI
- Home: Key_Super_L (and Meta/Menu) press AND release, from any surface, replicating handleHomeKeys guards (modalAlert.visible, homeView, access.ribbon, settingsService.disableHome, bootFirstUse) then launch LumaHome instead of launchDefaultApp(home). Today the filter only acts on the Home surface (global.activeSurfaceAppId==com.webos.app.home && fullscreenView.activeFocus) and relies on the home stub for the rest. Decide explicitly about Home long press (Screen Zoom), otherwise swallowing Home removes that accessibility feature (re-expose via global.enableZoomHelper / zoom).
- Settings gear: quicksettings main is already redirected through configd systemUIManager appinfo, so NO key interception is needed for the short press; only intercept if gear-long (com.palm.app.settings, via Key_Option) or the YouTube forwarding (appLaunch.js:2246) must change.
- Input picker: same story, quickinputpicker main can be redirected in systemUIManager appinfo; key interception not needed. Input long (Key_Video -> homeconnect) can be repointed via configd com.webos.keyaction.inputHub (action/id) rather than code.
- Apps / notification drawer: no key exists; implement as LumaHome UI actions or on Menu key (Home path).
- MUST stay untouched (return NextPolicy): Power, Volume +/-/Mute (and its 2 s accessibility hold), CH +/-, digits (Magic Number slot 22, 1000 ms), Back and Exit in apps (only claim Back while LumaHome itself is fullscreen and focused), CursorShow/CursorHide, Voice/Search/CP keys, Netflix/Prime etc., ScreenRemote and Guide when LG's UIs are wanted, color keys in Live TV/HDMI, Local keys, factory/service keys, anything while alerts/VKB/pincode hold focus (those make fullscreenView.activeFocus false, which the current guard already respects).

(c) SIDE EFFECTS THAT BREAK IF SLOT 1 SWALLOWS A KEY
1. Screen-saver idle timer lives in slot 5 (handleScreenSaver -> keyPressed -> restartUserActivityTimer, 120000 ms, ignored while the pointer is visible). A key swallowed in slot 1 never restarts it, so navigating LumaHome by remote only can let the screensaver start after ~2 min. LumaTV must call the exposed luna method restartUserActivityTimer (StarfishExtendedLunaServiceAPI.qml:129-140, service appId = LS.appId + '.screenSaver') or emit the same signal itself.
2. Long-press logic lives in slot 4 (handleLongPressKeys) for Back/Exit, Settings/Option, Input/Video, Guide/List/ChannelDash, ScreenRemote, Red. Anything swallowed earlier loses its long form (1000 ms), its short-press replay and its pointer handling; the key is swallowed on press and only delivered at RELEASE for these keys. The compositor preProcess skips MRCU cursor show/hide and key-speak for these keys (StarfishKeyFilter.qml:321-330), because the long-press handler does it, so a slot-1 handler must call global.setMRCUCursorVisibility(key, deviceId) / speakKey itself for Settings, Input, Back, Red, Guide, ScreenRemote or the Magic Remote pointer will not show/hide correctly.
3. Replayed keys re-enter the chain from slot 1: handleLongPressKeys replays short presses and long-press keys through global.sendKeyToFocusWindow (skipKeyPress/skipKeyRelease flags and the 'skip internally posted key' TTS flag prove re-entry), and handleHomeKeys replays Home with isInternalHomeKey. handleLumaHome therefore sees each such key twice; it must be idempotent (act on the original or on the replay, not both) [INFERENCE from the flags; native re-entry not visible in QML].
4. One shared longPressTimer: set() resets pending timers, so a LumaTV timer would cancel LG's pending Mute/Home/digit timers; LumaTV timers should use their own Timer. It is also cancelled whenever the active focus item changes, and on any keyFilters config write (which also unsubscribes ALL filter luna subscriptions and reruns init() of every file).
5. Long-press spinner (ring after 500 ms) only appears if option.remoteSlowInput is on (off here); if turned on LG also stretches all thresholds to option.longPressInterval, LumaTV timers would not.
6. Digits must reach slot 22 or Quick Access (hold 1000 ms) and Italy similarlist die; Mute must reach slot 7 (long) and slot 16 (toggle); Settings must reach slot 8 (x3 AV reset) if that hidden menu matters.
7. Back handling for alerts, toast-closing, overlays and screenRemote lives in handleSystemKeys; claiming Back on the Home surface is safe only because alerts/VKB steal activeFocus.

(d) GAME MODE. None of the four files branches on game mode. gamepad keys never open Game Dashboard/Optimizer. The Game Dashboard appears from the stock QuickSettings app: its UIController opens the dashboard in Game mode when launched by the Settings key or by the `reason:preload` launch (QuickSettings.qml:46-80, UIController.qml:100-156). The preload comes from appLaunch.js init(): resetting isSystemUIPreloaded (line 611) then cb_getBootStatus -> preloadSystemUI (801-840) which sends systemUIManager/launch quicksettings + quickinputpicker reason preload; rewriting configd keyFilters reruns init() and so reopens it in Game mode. Quick Settings main is now LumaGlass's file, so whether the stock dashboard still appears depends on that file (not verified). profile.list on this set has no 'gaming' (supportGaming false), so the gaming local-key layout only logs (appLaunch.js:3559-3572); Key_Game is soccer-mode in tvhotkey, not Game Optimizer; HDMI-only Green x7 shows FreeSync info. The live settings: HDMI game input swaps go through Input key -> quickinputpicker.
